mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are seeing 51 degree temperatures with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. The Full Moon is out tonight, and while the ISS is passing overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will drop to 47 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting meetings to discuss the US 18/151 Corridor Study, which covers the area from Dodgeville to the McKee Road interchange in Fitchburg. They are looking for public feedback on initial design concepts, with both in-person and virtual meeting options available.
There is plenty to do in Verona starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee.

In a report from October 21, officers from the Verona Police Department assisted at a residence on Basswood Avenue for a witnessed cardiac arrest, where their AED was successfully deployed before the patient was transported to the hospital.
Today's flavor of the day is the seasonal favorite, Pumpkin Pecan. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a treat.
